interpretation: The numerically clean exact-theta+C plus K-lookup architecture preserves Richards response but lookup transform/search/reconstruction overhead exceeds analytical K evaluation under the longer paired protocol.
next_direction: Test a derivative-consistent interpolated retention representation in which theta and C are generated from the same interpolant, preserving Jacobian/residual consistency while avoiding repeated analytical power evaluations.
nonclaims: This rejects K-only lookup as a speed candidate for the tested implementation and fixture, not tabulation generally.
